title: Causal Identification under Systematic Selection with Fixed Observed Support
banked_reason: The final redesign removes operational circularity, but the unconditional field contribution remains exactly the unproved all-residual dichotomy; fiber-constant targets may be nonrational and nonconstant fibers may admit no rational-affine exact-support twin box.
gap_reasons: The final redesign removes operational circularity, but the unconditional field contribution remains exactly the unproved all-residual dichotomy.
Fiber-constant polynomial targets may be nonrational, and nonconstant fibers may admit no rational-affine exact-support box.
Repair would require narrowing the headline, strengthening assumptions, broadening certificate types, or another architecture redesign.
proof_attempt_summary: Four architecture attempts replaced oracle agendas and hidden required-district choices with an input-determined, case-by-case LGS task machine using computed fixing sequences, a step-indexed positivity ledger, and multiset termination. The final architecture established the nonresidual soundness, termination, positive-formula preservation, worked certificate, and ordinary-ID reduction, but generic elimination and witness-lifting attempts did not prove the universal residual converse. The open items are oeq:all-residual-dichotomy, thm:formula-or-global-twin-completeness, and prop:interior-wald-inference.
tldr: For finite selector-gated semi-Markovian SCMs observed on exactly \(H\), retained support normalization and a deterministic Algorithms 1--2 task machine preserve every successful support-licensed formula, certify every actual division, and terminate at a sound formula, a verifier-accepted support-exact twin, or an explicitly pending residual. The all-residual rational-formula-or-global-twin dichotomy remains the sole missing step, so the field completeness theorem is retained as the headline but is not claimed as proved.
gap: The published systematic-selection recursion is sound and has branchwise nonidentification results, but its completeness is conjectural and its failure construction is not typed as a support-exact, restricted-interior pair preserving every cell of the one supplied joint law. Its proofs also do not normalize a declared selector support while retaining the exact structural parameter image.
fill: The project constructs the intrinsic normalized carrier \(\Lambda_H\), proves its constrained subset \(\mathcal I_H\) equals the original fixed-support image, and develops an exact four-relation SA-CS-ID machine with local algebraic obligations, a denominator-by-denominator positivity ledger, deterministic priority, and a per-transition lexicographic decrease. Its all-residual theorem returns a partial rational formula with a complete positive domain or support-exact global twins; component and fixed-linear-contrast Wald intervals use a declared vectorization and have pointwise coverage only at a fixed interior law.
